description: This file defines the TcpIoStream class, which implements the IoStream interface for TCP socket communication. It manages input/output streams, handles writing data, setting input listeners, and closing the stream.

classes.name: TcpIoStream
classes.description: Implements IoStream for TCP communication, managing input/output streams and a connection loop for incoming data.

methods.name: TcpIoStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing input and output streams, with null checks.

methods.description: Writes bytes to the output stream and flushes.

methods.name: setInputListener
methods.description: Sets a DataListener to run in a separate thread, continuously reading from the input stream.
